title: My Son-In-Law Sold My Seed Vault And Left Me A $4,500 Voucher. So I Voided The Sale.
description: I drained my $115K widow’s inheritance to build a heirloom seed bank with my son-in-law, who then forged a dissolution and sold my genetic stock for $830K, leaving me a $4,500 'compost' voucher. I found the original partnership agreement sealed in a glass seed jar in cold storage, voided the sale, and now run 'Seed of Deceit Gardens' where he transplants sprouts in a vest that says 'Planted Lies' and every seed packet prints the probate-fraud docket number. #SeedOfDeceit #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal
thumb_text: HE SOLD MY SEED VAULT AND LEFT ME A $4,500 VOUCHER
pinned_comment: Would you have taken the $4,500 'compost' voucher after your son-in-law sold your $115K inheritance seed bank for $830K, or would you have found the glass seed jar and voided the sale? Share your story in the comments.
